meta_description: Chief Security Officer at Achala IT Solutions — Owns the zero-exposure architecture, security operations and compliance posture.

blocks.x: The Chief Security Officer mandate at Achala IT Solutions: keep deliveries predictable, keep evidence honest, and stay personally reachable to the clients those deliveries serve.
We start Chief Security Officer by writing the mandate down, decision rights, budget authority and stop conditions, because unstated mandates are how programs drift.
How this office works with clients
The specifics behind chief security officer:
The practice behind Chief Security Officer is deliberately small per program, senior people, short feedback loops, and a rule that whoever designs it also sees it run.

items: We commit to Zero-trust architecture as a measured outcome, reported every fortnight, audited at the gate, owned by a name on both sides.
Security operations is tracked weekly against the baseline signed in week two, the number at each gate is the number finance sees.
Compliance is tracked weekly against the baseline signed in week two, the number at each gate is the number finance sees.

blocks.x: Contact the practice directly, briefings are 45 minutes, working-session format, no pitch deck required.
